# Scions of Erudition

# **Organisation:** {#organisation:}

**Leader:** Orasmyn  
**Inner Circle:**

* Vizaresh Nas  
* Ganang Manah  
* Haruvatat  
* Ind’ar Manutec

**Fleet Master:** Attrax Dronn (Iron Warrior)

# **Key Members:** {#key-members:}

## **Leader \- Orasmyn:** {#leader---orasmyn:}

The Scions of Erudition are led by the Sorcerer Lord Orasmyn. An exiled member of the  Thousand Sons legion, Orasmyn is a veteran of the Great Crusade and a terran marine who was among the first recruits of the fledgeling XVth legion. Serving under Captain Ohrmuzd Ahriman, Orasmyn fought in many great battles of the Great Crusade, rising through the ranks of the legion and eventually inheriting command of Ohrmuzd's company upon his death. Orasmyn became a member of the Athenaean cult upon the discovery of Magnus the Red on Prospero. Remaining at the forefront of Legion activities, he was present at the Council of Nikea, and was on Prospero when the Imperial forces lead by Leman Russ and Constantin Valdor attacked. During the attack he led his company in the defence of the planet. At the climax of the siege, Orasmyn was teleported with Magnus to Sortiarius.  
	As a member of Ahriman’s cabal and a participant in the casting of the Rubric, Orasmyn was exiled from the Legion alongside the rest of the conspirators. From this exile Orasmyn gathered around him much of what remained of his old company, thus forming the Scions of Erudition.

## **Inner Circle:** {#inner-circle:}

### **Vizaresh Nas** {#vizaresh-nas}

While the inner circle of the Scions of Erudition are all equal, Vizaresh Nas acts as de-facto second in command. A veteran of the heresy, Nas was a member of the Raptora cult on Prospero and is thus a very gifted telekine, skills he put to use as part of Orasmyn's company during the Great Crusade.  
    During the burning of Prospero, Nas duelled a Space Wolf champion one-on-one, a fight he won by telekinetically crushing the hand of his opponent, causing them to drop their axe which Nas caught and used to decapitate them. Nas has carried this axe with him ever since.  
    Nas followed Orasmyn into exile after the Rubric and is thus a founding member of the Scions of Erudition.  
    A brilliant duelist and cunning warrior, Vizaresh Nas has proved his worth in many battles. He is totally loyal to Orasmyn, with strong ties of brotherhood forged through many millennia.

### **Ganang Manah** {#ganang-manah}

Another founding member of the Scions of Erudition, Ganang Manah was also in Orasmyn's old company. Being a former Pavoni, Manah is fascinated by biology and spends days, sometimes weeks inside his laboratory on *The Mourning Prince* experimenting.  
    This fascination with biology has only grown during the Scion's time in and around the Eye of Terror, where mutation is rampant. To the mortal and beastmen crew of the warband's ships, a visit to your deck by Ganang Manah can only mean some of your crewmates will never be seen again, added to his stock of test subjects.  
    Alongside his own personal projects, Manah is also in charge of the warband's production and stores of the meme-virus they use to gather information. The recipe of this viral concoction is under constant change and improvement by Manah, and the effectiveness only grows with each change.

### **Ind’ar Manutec** {#ind’ar-manutec}

## **Fleet Master \- Attrax Dronn** {#fleet-master---attrax-dronn}

Attrax Dronn was the first non Thousand Son to join the Scions of Erudition, doing so some time around M33.  
A former member of the Iron Warriors legion, Dronn was a relatively new member of the legion at the outbreak of the Heresy. On the ground during the siege, Dronn saw direct action upon the soil of Terra. With the Iron Warriors withdrawal from the siege and eventual settling on Medrengard, Dronn attempted to learn all he could from the more experienced members of his legion.  
    While learning a lot from the rest of his legion, he became frustrated at the inaction and perceived complacency of his warsmith Berossus, Attrax left Medrengard looking for somewhere to test and develop his skills. Somewhere he could be respected.

# **History** {#history}

## **Initial Formation** {#initial-formation}

As a member of Ahriman’s cabal who had helped cast the Rubric, the Thousand Sons Sorcerer Orasmyn was banished from the Sortiarius with the rest of the co-conspirators. After his exile from the Planet of Sorcerers, many members of the company Orasmyn had led during the Great Crusade decided to follow their former leader into exile, pledging to follow his lead in a time that the wider legion felt directionless. A such, they set out to scour the galaxy for any hidden knowledge, seeking not only to enlighten themselves, but to hopefully find the reason the Rubric failed.

## **Early History** {#early-history}

The Scions of Erudition now search the galaxy seeking artefacts, tomes, and even people that can add to their already massive repository of knowledge, as well as to bring retribution to those who have wronged them and their legion. To this end they maintain vast networks of informants across the galaxy. A favoured way to encourage the accumulation of knowledge is for the Scions of Erudition (or those in service to them) to visit a planet and covertly spread a meme-virus that drives those infected to crave and collect any and all information and knowledge. They will then return years or decades later, after the virus has spread and its carriers collected vast amounts of information, to collect this knowledge. Uber Aemos, famed savant to Inquisitor Gregor Eisenhorn, was infected with his meme-virus due to the actions of the Scions of Erudition.

While they have largely avoided the fighting between the many warbands of the traitor legions, the Scions of Erudition are regularly sought out by representatives of these factions who are looking to trade for information, especially when they look to make raids into Imperium space. The Scions of Erudition themselves have become somewhat of a group of information brokers, usually trading for more information or psychically gifted recruits they can train, though they have been known to accept other things as payment.

## **Ahriman’s Re-Emergence** {#ahriman’s-re-emergence}

Orasmyn was one of the exiled Thousand Sons to answer Ahriman’s call to Prospero in M32 to defend him and his Prodigal Sons from the Inquisition while they enacted a ritual that would teleport them to Sortiarius. This became the Third Battle of Prospero, where Orasmyn commanded his fleet to fight alongside many of his former brothers, including Iskander Khayon of the Black Legion, successfully driving back the Inquisition and allowing the Prodigal Sons to reach the Planet of the Sorcerers.

Intrigued by the re-emergence of his former brother, Orasmyn sought out Ahriman after his attempted second rubric. While the Scions of Erudition did not officially join Ahriman’s Prodigal Sons, the two warbands would work together on countless occasions in efforts and raids aimed at finding any hint or clue as to how to return their brothers, with the Scions of Erudition’s large stores of knowledge and vast networks of informants proving invaluable. Examples include the “Death of Dianaxis”, the raiding of the Harlequin library on Arcadia, and the harvesting of souls on Calliope.

### **Death Guard:**  {#death-guard:}

While there have been times that the Scions of Erudition have fought alongside the Death Guard, they will avoid doing so if at all possible. Mortarion was the most outspoken against the use of ibrarians at the Council of Nikaea, which earned him the animosity of the Thousand Sons at large, and especially Orasmyn who was present at the council to hear his words. His ascension to a daemon prince has not diminished this.  
	Individual warbands are dealt with on a case by case basis. If respect is shown by the Death Guard, respect will be given back, if begrudgingly so.

## **Notable Engagements** {#notable-engagements}

* **M32 \- Third Battle of Prospero:** One of the warbands to answer Ahriman’s call to defend the Prodigal Sons from the Inquisition when he attempted to teleport to Sortiarius to cast the second rubric.  
* **??? \- Mundus**: Infiltrated the planet’s sanctioned psyker organisation in order to extract recruits and information.  
* **??? \- Death of Dianixis:** Aided Ahriman in his quest for the skull of Lepidus.  
* **??? \- Arcadia:** Plundered the Arcadian Librarium of the Harlequins  
* **???.M41 \- Calliope:** The harvesting of the planet's souls, overseen by [Ahriman](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Ahriman).  
* **999.M41 \- Siege of the Fenris System:** One of the Exiles reconvened by Ahriman to aid Magnus and the rest of the Thousand Sons in attacking the Space Wolf homeworld. An elaborate plan by Magnus to transport the [Planet of the Sorcerers](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Planet_of_the_Sorcerers) to the Materium over [Prospero](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Prospero).  
* **999.M41 \- War in the Labyrinth:** With [Ahriman](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Ahriman) and other exiles as they battle the [Ynnari](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Ynnari) in the [Webway](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Webway).  
* **999.M41 \- 13th Black Crusade:** With [Ahriman](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Ahriman) and other exiles as they attempt to raid the [Eldar](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Eldar) [Black Library](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Black_Library).  
* **???.[M42](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/M42) \- The [Prosperan Rift War](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Prosperan_Rift_War):** The Thousand Sons expand their holdings in Imperial space from [Sortiarius](https://wh40k.lexicanum.com/wiki/Sortiarius).
